snippet.title: Zero-G Alpha release 4.9.0
snippet.description:
📡 PROJECT ZERO-G | ALPHA 4.9.0: THE CORPORATE DAWN
JOIN THE SHARD: https://space.zerog.live/
COMMAND CENTER (Discord): https://discord.gg/C9dWFP2jJt

“Space is no longer a vacuum. It is a territory.”
We have officially crossed the 1,000-pilot milestone. The Founding Pilots are etched into our history, and the gate to the Vanguard 5000 is now open. Alpha 4.9.0 represents the most significant architectural shift in Zero-G history: the transition from individual survival to organizational logistics and planetary colonization.

🚀 WHAT IS NEW IN ALPHA 4.9.0?

1. VENTURE DEPOTS & EARTH COLONIZATION
The Vatican Academy has authorized the first civilian colonization protocols. Player organizations (Ventures) can now acquire permanent "Earth Depot Licenses."
Territorial Claims: Claim specific quadrants on the Earth's surface using 1:1 NASA topographic maps.
Player-Run Economy: Directors set buy/sell prices, markups, and budget limits. Create your own trade hub and attract independent pilots to your sector.

2. THE ALIEN RESEARCH TOKEN ECONOMY
First Contact near Mars was violent. Now, we reverse-engineer the threat.
Token System: Introducing Alien Points, a new currency acquired by donating Alien Scraps to the Alien Research Center (ARC) at the Vatican Academy.
ARC Storage: Collected debris is stored for global research phases, leading toward the discovery of FTL travel.

3. SHARED PROSPERITY
We believe in the strength of the wing.
Venture Rewards: Strategic support now benefits everyone. When a pilot purchases a special offer, unique rewards are granted to EVERY member of their Venture.

4. TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE & STABILITY
Undock Protocol Fixed: Transitioning from Starbase to deep space is now 100% fluid—no browser reloads required.
Planetary Sensor Array (PSAR): Toggle the detection network with the 'P' key. Track ship signatures in real-time across 25 million km via WebSockets.
Ship Tracking 2.0: New compact tracking cards with the ⚡ INTERCEPT button for rapid tactical deployment.
Performance Optimization: Asset-heavy renders replaced with high-performance Animated GIF layers to support "Potato PCs" and background-tab persistence.
